title: Add plural resource tasks_ready_restore_count

acceptance_criteria: app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml gains a <plurals name="tasks_ready_restore_count"> with "one" item "%1$d task ready to restore" and "other" item "%1$d tasks ready to restore"
start_anchor: <string name="paste_backup_json_message">Paste a full data backup JSON below. This will replace ALL current data.</string>
exact_code:
